Priya (CS): FYI — AcmeCorp reporting large spike of 5xx and timeouts on hosted /v1/generate since ~18:12 UTC. Multiple customers affected. They pasted a curl and say tokens stall after ~3s.
Aisha (oncall): I'm looking. Any repro payloads or client headers?
Priya (CS): They sent this minimal repro, customer says it used to be fine:
Priya (CS): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"summarize: long text...","max_tokens":512}'```
DevOps Bot: Alert: hosted-inference-gateway error-rate (5xx) crossed threshold in eu-west-1, rate=4.8% (5m).
Marco (runtime): Seeing elevated tail latency on multitenant gateway -> runtime handoff. KV cache misses spiked. Correlating with model:redwood-large v3.
Sam (infra): NLB connection resets increased at 18:10. Could be a downstream runtime thread starvation or connection keepalive expiry.
Aisha (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) switch heavy tenants on redwood-large->redwood-large-1 (lighter variant) using routing policy 2) temporarily increase gateway circuit backoff thresholds 3) scale dedicated pools + extra replica in eu-west. I'll trigger the routing change now.
Aisha (oncall): Marco / Sam please check runtime logs and the kernel selection telemetry for spikes during 18:05-18:20.
Marco (runtime): Pulling logs. Noting many "kv-cache: miss" followed by "worker: OOM-reclaim" messages on a subset of pods. Looks like an eviction cascade causing longer queuing.
Priya (CS): Customer impact: 7 tenants reported failures, highest severity for two paying customers. CS asked for ETA and workaround.
Sam (infra): I enabled one extra pool node in eu-west and nudged NLB keepalive to 120s; rolling restart disabled.
DevOps Bot: Deploy bot: routing override applied: route redwood-large -> redwood-large-1 for tenants [acme, beta-inc] at 18:28 UTC by Aisha.
Aisha (oncall): After routing change errors dropped to 0.8% in 5m window. Still seeing elevated p95 latency but steady.
Marco (runtime): Confirmed. The eviction logs show a memory pressure ramp tied to quantized attention cache size for that model variant under long sequences. Root cause candidate: cache sizing + default eviction aggressiveness mis-tuned after v3 kernel selector tweak.
Priya (CS): Shared status with customers and asked for logs and sample request IDs. They provided req ids: rq_44b9, rq_44bA, rq_44c0.
Aisha (oncall): Action items I want in this thread:
Aisha (oncall): - Marco: produce a short RCA note with timeline + root cause hypothesis and safe mitigation (tune eviction and kernel selector rollback).
Aisha (oncall): - Sam: review autoscale thresholds & NLB keepalive defaults; propose hardening.
Aisha (oncall): - Priya: follow up with affected customers with ETA and mitigation steps (routing override + retry guidance).
Aisha (oncall): - Ops: add a synthetic test that simulates long-seq kv-cache pressure for redwood-large to catch regressions.
Marco (runtime): I'll revert the kernel selector tweak in a canary and test cache behavior; pushing a config fix and will post results.
Sam (infra): I'll write a config doc for NLB keepalive + pool scaling and add a playbook entry for connection-reset patterns.
Priya (CS): I'll send targeted customer notes and include a recommended client-side retry backoff: exponential starting at 200ms up to 2s, and suggest pinning to redwood-large-1 for now.
Aisha (oncall): Post-incident follow-up: we'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize the RCA and set rollout plan for the kernel selector rollback. Priya, please include affected customer list and their SLAs.
Priya (CS): Ack. Also requesting a short template we can use for CS comms for similar incidents.
Marco (runtime): Posting interim logs for the window (18:08-18:22):
Marco (runtime): ```
[18:09:11] pod-12 runtime: kv-cache: miss seq=2048 size=7.6MB
[18:09:12] pod-12 runtime: alloc failure: reclaiming pages
[18:09:13] pod-12 runtime: worker queue depth=94 latency=1320ms
[18:10:02] pod-34 runtime: kv-cache: miss seq=1024 size=3.1MB
[18:11:00] pod-34 runtime: evicting entries, latency back to normal
```
Sam (infra): Also attaching NLB metrics: spikes on active connections and resets at 18:10. I'll correlate with autoscaler logs.
Aisha (oncall): Good. For the backlog: add a guard in the kernel selector to avoid the new path for models with long-seq distributions until we have cache protections.
Priya (CS): Customer comms sent: short note + workaround. One customer still asking for credit; I'll escalate to support billing.
Aisha (oncall): If billing team needs notes, Priya include timeline and impacted request ids.
DevOps Bot: Incident summary saved to incident-tracker id: INC-2025-1789994321.
Aisha (oncall): Closing immediate thread; we'll reconvene in the scheduled follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
